local_review.finding_body: The contribution added -H:+SharedArenaSupport to the 1.0.39 suite shared by 61 older tested versions, although that baseline suite previously passed without the option. Native flags require uniform necessity. The target 1.3.0 WebSocket server path does require the narrow option: without it Netty 4.2.7's WebSocketServerHandshaker releases an unpooled direct response through CleanerJava25 and reaches disabled Arena.ofShared; default epoll, NIO, preferred-heap, and direct-to-heap allocator variants all reproduced that mechanism.
local_review.finding_title: Version-specific native-image flag applied to a shared test suite
local_review.fix_note: Restored the shared 1.0.39 suite unchanged, split 1.3.0 into its own test project, moved the generated test-only metadata there, and retained -H:+SharedArenaSupport only for 1.3.0. The original eight HTTP and WebSocket tests and assertions remain unchanged.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the target-coordinate scope, native-image repair, metadata format and conditions, index integrity, test-contract musts, and repair coverage. Both old and new dynamic-access reports are 0/0, so the ordered repair gate passes at the no-call step. The stable Forge finalization run passed all 8 tests in current-defaults, future-defaults, and GraalVM 25 lanes, plus metadata, style, generated-test, and statistics checks without further publishable changes.
